# Capacitor Mobile Rules (`Capacitor v7`)

## Configuration & Native Projects
- Store Capacitor configuration in `capacitor.config.ts`.
- Ensure platform sync command `pnpm cap sync` is run
  after updating native plugins or web build outputs.
- Keep `ios/` and `android/` native project metadata
  synchronized with app versioning.

## Native Plugins & Features
- Use official Capacitor v7 plugins (`@capacitor/core`,
  `@capacitor/camera`, `@capacitor/push-notifications`).
- Wrap native plugin invocations in platform checks
  (`Capacitor.isNativePlatform()`).
- Handle device safe areas using CSS env vars (`safe-area-inset-*`).

## Files matching `packages/web/**/*.{vue,ts,json}`

# Vue 3 & Quasar Architecture Guidelines (`packages/web`)

## Core Tech Stack
- **Framework**: Vue 3 (Composition API, `<script setup lang="ts">`).
- **UI Toolkit**: Quasar Framework (v2) with Vite (`@quasar/app-vite`).
- **Styling**: SCSS + Quasar CSS utility classes.
- **State Management**: Pinia (`defineStore`).
- **Routing**: Vue Router 4 (`createRouter`).
- **Mobile Build**: Capacitor (v7) for iOS and Android.
- **Auth Client**: Better Auth client.

## Directory Layout
- **Components (`src/components/`)**: Reusable UI elements
  using Quasar components (`QBtn`, `QCard`, `QInput`).
- **Pages (`src/pages/`)**: Route-level views.
- **Layouts (`src/layouts/`)**: Page structural wrappers
  (`QLayout`, `QHeader`, `QPageContainer`).
- **Stores (`src/stores/`)**: Pinia store definitions for
  global application state and auth session state.
- **Router (`src/router/`)**: Route definitions and auth guards.

## Files matching `packages/web/**/*.{vue,ts,scss}`

# Vue 3 & Quasar Code Style Rules

## Single File Components (SFCs)
- Use `<script setup lang="ts">` for all Vue components.
- Order SFC tags: `<script setup>`, `<template>`, `<style lang="scss">`.
- Define props using `defineProps<{ ... }>()` type-only declarations.
- Emits must use `defineEmits<{ ... }>()`.

## UI & Styling
- Prefer standard Quasar components (`q-btn`, `q-input`, `q-dialog`)
  over raw HTML where applicable.
- Leverage Quasar flex/grid utilities (`row`, `col`, `q-pa-md`, `q-gutter-sm`).
- Write scoped SCSS (`<style lang="scss" scoped>`) for custom component styles.

## State Management & Better Auth
- Use Pinia setup syntax (`defineStore('name', () => { ... })`).
- Initialize Better Auth client in a boot plugin (`src/boot/auth.ts`).
- Handle loading states and reactive errors cleanly in template.
